title: The ordinary universal derived tensor triangle row
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in one universe with R-algebras A and B and an A tensor_R B-algebra C. Choose derived categories of R-, A-, and B-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let T be an A-cochain triangle whose localized image is distinguished. Choose universal base-derived tensor cohomology models m1,m2,m3 for the vertices [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. In each degree i there are A tensor_R B-linear maps between m1.H(i), m2.H(i), m3.H(i), m1.H(i+1), m2.H(i+1) forming an exact five-term sequence. Their four squares with the ordinary model comparison maps commute with the homology of T.mor1, T.mor2, the actual homology boundary, and T.mor1 in degree i+1 after ordinary scalar extension A to A tensor_R B [def-weil-module-base-change]. No flatness of C or localizedComparison map is used.

source.place: Lemma 15.61.1; expansion of the parent triangle-row proof before final flat scalar extension.

proof.text: Equip the first universal derived model and its counit with coherent shifts. Construct the three canonical same-degree maps by the model-map theorem. Complete them with the canonical exact-row boundary.

The same-degree ordinary squares follow from counit naturality, comparison_eq, ordinaryIso pure-tensor naturality and faithful restriction. Apply the ordinary boundary-square theorem to the boundary formula.

theorem exists_baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel_ordinary_triangle_rows
    (R A B C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) C]
    [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)] [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ))
    (hT : DerivedCategory.Q.mapTriangle.obj T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles)
    (m₁ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B T.obj₁ C)
    (m₂ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B T.obj₂ C)
    (m₃ : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B T.obj₃ C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    ∃ (s₀ : m₁.cohomology i ⟶ m₂.cohomology i)
      (s₁ : m₂.cohomology i ⟶ m₃.cohomology i)
      (s₂ : m₃.cohomology i ⟶ m₁.cohomology (i + 1))
      (s₃ : m₁.cohomology (i + 1) ⟶ m₂.cohomology (i + 1)),
      (ComposableArrows.mk₄ s₀ s₁ s₂ s₃).Exact ∧
      s₀ ≫ m₂.comparison i =
        m₁.comparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map T.mor₁) i ∧
      s₁ ≫ m₃.comparison i =
        m₂.comparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map T.mor₂) i ∧
      s₂ ≫ m₁.comparison (i + 1) = m₃.comparison i ≫
        CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle (F.mapTriangle.obj T) i (i + 1) ∧
      s₃ ≫ m₂.comparison (i + 1) = m₁.comparison (i + 1) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (F.map T.mor₁) (i + 1)
